query: INSERT INTO appointments (id, owner_user_id, starts_at, ends_at, reference, caller_name, caller_e164, contact, subject, call_id, chat_id) SELECT $1, a.owner_user_id, $2, $3, a.reference, a.caller_name, a.caller_e164, a.contact, a.subject, $4, $5 FROM appointments a WHERE a.id = $6 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
